keys: Task 1: `column_stats` mean = sum / number of numeric cells; regression test for `k,v / a,10 / b, / c,20` → mean 15 passes; `python3 tally.py <that file> --column v` prints mean 15
Task 4: `--delimiter` option (default `,`, `tab` → `\t`, other values longer than one char → `tally: error: …` on stderr, exit 2) with tests in a new test file; tests pass

Task 5: `format_cell`, `format_table`, `round_numbers`, `render` live in `render.py`, imported back into `tally.py`; `git diff --quiet main -- test_tally.py` succeeds and `python3 -m unittest -q` passes

Task 3: README "Examples" section with three invocations against `data/sample.csv` (amount summary, grouped by region, JSON top-2 products); a script re-runs each command and its output matches the README block byte for byte

Task 2: `notes/missing-values.md` with `# Missing values`, table (Function | Situation | Behavior | Described in README) covering every handling site, and a final `## Gaps` section; every row checked against the code by running a probe
Final check: full suite passes, `test_tally.py` unchanged, work committed on a feature branch (not main)
